display_long_description:
Villada invites you to explore its Plaza Mayor in an immersive way and discover the living memory of the municipality. This application, promoted by the Villada Town Council and developed by Irzón Ingenieros, digitizes the square and turns it into an interactive space where every corner has something to tell.

Explore at your own pace and tap the points of interest to:
- Compare “then and now” with historical photographs placed exactly where they were once taken.  
- Watch relevant videos about social life and local traditions.  
- Access interactive content that explains transformations, anecdotes, and milestones of the community.

Designed for residents, visitors, schools, and history lovers, Villada offers an intuitive experience: enter, move around the digital square and, with a tap, images, stories, and scenes appear to help you understand how the heart of the town has changed, and how it beats today.

What makes Villada special:
- Heritage and technology come together in a friendly, educational experience.  
- Geolocated historical photographs that show the evolution of each spot in the square.  
- Videos and interactive elements curated by the Town Council to provide cultural context and value.  
- Clear, accessible interface—ideal for discovering, learning, and enjoying.

Download it and experience Villada’s Plaza Mayor with fresh eyes: a visit that unites past and present so every walk has history.  
A project by the Villada Town Council, developed by Irzón Ingenieros.
